???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "Which blocks form the natural loop of a back edge?"

        The back edge's target, its header, together with every block that can reach the back edge's source without passing through the header. Every edge from outside the loop enters at the header.

        Introduced in [O2. Control-flow graphs and dominance](o2-cfg-and-dominance.md).

    ??? question "In which style of IR is every named value assigned exactly once, so that a changing variable becomes a series of versions?"

        Static single assignment (SSA) form.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "What does it mean for block X to dominate block Y, and what does the dominator tree record?"

        Every path from the entry to Y passes through X. Making each block a child of its immediate dominator gives the dominator tree, where X dominates Y exactly when X is Y or an ancestor of Y.

        Introduced in [O2. Control-flow graphs and dominance](o2-cfg-and-dominance.md).
